description: This file defines the Marshaler class responsible for marshalling and unmarshalling JSON documents and PHP data structures into DynamoDB item formats. It provides methods to handle different DynamoDB data types and options to customize marshaling behavior.

classes.name: Marshaler
classes.description: A class that handles marshaling and unmarshaling data between PHP types/structures and DynamoDB item representations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Marshaler object with optional configuration options.

methods.name: binary
methods.description: Creates a special object to represent a DynamoDB binary (B) value.

methods.name: number
methods.description: Creates a special object to represent a DynamoDB number (N) value.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Creates a special object to represent a DynamoDB set (SS/NS/BS) value.

methods.name: marshalJson
methods.description: Converts a JSON string into a DynamoDB item structure.

methods.name: marshalItem
methods.description: Converts a PHP array or object into a DynamoDB item structure.

methods.name: marshalValue
methods.description: Converts a PHP value into a DynamoDB attribute value.

methods.name: unmarshalJson
methods.description: Converts a DynamoDB item into a JSON string.

methods.name: unmarshalItem
methods.description: Converts a DynamoDB item into a PHP array or object.

methods.name: unmarshalValue
methods.description: Converts a DynamoDB attribute value into a PHP scalar, array, or stdClass.

methods.name: handleInvalid
methods.description: Handles invalid values during marshaling according to configuration.
